video_title: YouTube title: 'HE'S GASSED!' - Kendrick Perkins says Victor Wembanyama's pregame warmup is ALARMING 👀 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama must play with more aggression from the start
quotes.excerpt: He's been low energy in the first half of these games. You cannot have four shots.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: He has got to be more aggressive from the jump of this game.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: If you go back and look at the Western Conference Finals when they played against the Thunder, when he played his best games, he came out with intent. He came out with an aggression at the opening tip-off. I know you're not supposed to play that way. I know the best players are supposed to set their teammates up and then go take it in the end. That's certainly the way Jalen Brunson plays. I don't think that's the best way for Victor to approach it at this point. He's been low energy in the first half of these games. You cannot have four shots in one half and 17 in the other.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama must be the red alert for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: It seems like he starts shooting the ball when he feels a red alert coming.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: When you start looking at the breakdown of his shots and where his shots are coming from, it seems like he starts shooting the ball when he feels a red alert coming. And it's like you have to be the red alert. We want him to be the emergency. And that's not just offensively, it's defensively.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremy Lin
text_blocks.text: You saw Nikola Jokic do it. Now you're seeing big body do it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's dominant offensive moment is not coming yet
quotes.excerpt: I'm here to tell you it's not going to happen.
quotes.quote: I know we're waiting on Wembanyama to have that dominant moment, that powerful moment offensively, but I'm here to tell you it's not going to happen. It's not going to happen because the tape that you just broke down, Jalen was perfect. It was great. And it also highlighted what the Knicks are doing.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's pregame warmups are too intense
quotes.excerpt: I'm sitting up here saying it is 40 to 35 minutes on the clock.
quotes.quote: I did hoop streams with Champ, but before hoop streams, I sat down and I watched Wembanyama warm up. And two things that was alarming to me. One, how much he was doing during the warmups. Two, the timing before the warmups. This is not the layup line. I'm talking about his individual workout. I'm sitting up here saying it is 40 to 35 minutes on the clock. You're supposed to be in the back saving your legs. Most guys don't be out there 35 to 40 minutes before the game starts. And then you asking, and then we're wondering why is he getting off to slow starts? It's because he's gassed.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama must choose his level of intensity
quotes.excerpt: He needs to decide how decisive he wants to be.
quotes.quote: He needs to decide how decisive he wants to be. Game one, he's forcing the issue, turnovers, forcing it one-on-two, not good decisions. Then in the first half of the second game, it's like he doesn't want to play up. He's overly passing. He needs to decide what mentality, what intensity am I going to play with and be consistent.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson has found a home in New York
quotes.excerpt: He got this job and this is his family here.

text_blocks.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
text_blocks.text: When he signed here, it's not hard to find compilations of people saying, oh, they overpaid for him, oh, they just signed him because Leon Rose used to be his agent. But he got this job and this is his family here. People underestimated how comfortable he is with his family here where this stage can be bright and hot and melt other people. This is his family.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: And when he first got here, he studied the other king in New York, Derek Jeter.

quotes.speaker: Michael C. Wright
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs are facing a hostile environment in New York
quotes.excerpt: They know it's going to be probably the toughest environment that they've ever played in.
quotes.quote: They know it's going to be probably the toughest environment that they've ever played in because look, you got the president coming in and they know that they're going to be a little inconvenience. De'Aaron Fox is more than a shooter around. He was talking about how their spring is like TSA right now. He said all our buses are a little bit earlier than normal. Everything is changed and you have to realize that this is a team that is very inexperienced in the first place.
